wedge.note: above mu 0.36 the nose simply stays where it is on the ramp: it is never driven inward

alternative_one_per_slider.each: o 3 x 0.3, free 21.2, k 0.2 (E), tab + bar pocket 10 deep, seated on the rib face
alternative_one_per_slider.one_spring_fails: that bolt has NO return force: it can sit retracted (one bolt holds the pack)
alternative_one_per_slider.why_not: a broken or lost spring leaves one bolt dead instead of both at half force; each spring sits on the slider's centre line (no squaring couple); the 4.0 rib carries a standing preload on each face (PCTG creep) and its seats are 1.0 deep at most

spring.chosen: two in parallel between the tabs: either one failing leaves both bolts sprung at half force (1.51 x the 35 g inertia), no standing load on the rib, a squaring couple on each slider

+y (away from the head).path: nub on the wedge foot -> rib -> cross walls; positive, self-locking for mu > 0.27
+y (away from the head).holds_note: with no wedge friction at all; no limit at mu 0.3

-y (onto the head).path: rim bands on the four heel pads; positive

+-x (across).path: pad friction, then the head's blade springs (each blade is sprung on its own: not positive)

+-z (along the pack).path: pad + wedge friction; positive stop: the nub on the tab arch

blade_entry.chamfers_beyond: recess mouth 1.0, tab plate edge 1.0: a blade up to 2.0 across still cams in (not swept)

hold_down.what: a notch in the receiver's end face at each of its four corners; a tongue on each of the funnel's sliding end walls enters one and bears DOWN on its lower face when the arm pushes the drone up
hold_down.frame: cartridge coords (x across, y up from the flat bottom, z along the pack); seat_frame gives the same boxes in the funnel's seat frame (x nose, y left, z up)
hold_down.bearing_face: the notch's lower face (y 6.0); 5.8 of drawn PCTG under it

tongue.note: the same lane and height on both drones; 3.0 high in the 4.0 notch (0.5 over and under: the drone may lift 0.5 before the tongues bear); flat underside; 2.0 of the 2.5 depth

hold_down.clearances_at_landing: the notches are inside the receiver's outline: the funnel fit, its 65 landing states and the free play are unchanged. The end walls must park at least 2.5 mm further out than their seated gap while the drone lands and leaves (tongue 2.0 + 0.5), then drive in; seated, the receiver can sit 0.63 to the nose, 0.63 to the tail, 0.7 across before the funnel stops it
